scope: Descriptive corporate-structure dataset only: ownership, listed entities, apex holding vehicles, key officeholders, notable subsidiaries and foreign partners. Contains no allegations, investigations or wrongdoing claims by design.

methodology.marketCapSource: Screener.in company pages, read 2026-08-11 (intraday). Figures in Rs crore, rounded as displayed.
methodology.promoterHoldingSource: Screener.in shareholding-pattern tables, which reproduce SEBI/exchange quarterly shareholding filings. Quarter of each figure noted per entity in 'asOfQuarter'.
methodology.combinedMcapCr: Computed as the sum of the mcapCr values of the listedEntities present in THIS file for that group. For groups where only a subset of listed entities is covered, this is a partial figure and is flagged in the group 'notes'.
methodology.nullPolicy: Any shareholding %, subsidiary, stake or figure that could not be verified against a cited source is set to null and the gap is described in 'notes' or in the top-level 'gaps' array. No value in this file is estimated or inferred.

disambiguation.twoAmbaniGroups: There are two entirely separate 'Reliance' groups descended from Dhirubhai Ambani's businesses, split in 2005. (1) Reliance Industries Limited group — controlled by MUKESH Ambani; flagship RIL (NSE: RELIANCE), plus Jio Financial Services, Network18, and unlisted Jio Platforms and Reliance Retail Ventures. This is group id 'reliance' in this file. (2) Reliance Group (ADAG) — controlled by ANIL Ambani; includes Reliance Power (NSE: RPOWER) and Reliance Infrastructure (NSE: RELINFRA). Anil Ambani's companies are NOT part of Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries group and share no common promoter entity. They are recorded in this file under groups[0].separateAnilAmbaniGroup, deliberately NOT inside groups[0].listedEntities, so that any downstream aggregation of the 'Reliance' group does not conflate them.

groups.name: Reliance Industries Group (Mukesh Ambani)
groups.holdingEntity: No single apex trust or holding company. Control is held through a promoter group of ~60+ individuals and closely held entities that jointly hold the promoter stake in RIL; principal promoter-group corporate holders include Devarshi Commercials LLP, Karuna Commercials LLP, Tattvam Enterprises LLP, Srichakra Commercials LLP, Svar Enterprises LLP, Vasuprada Enterprises LLP, Shreeji Comtrade LLP and Shrikrishna Tradecom LLP.
